Guitar Pro 8.1.5 build31 native saves, UI facts and MIDI note-on/off events with hashes; exact native note retention, sound timing, 17-value gain sweep and notation flags.

resolution: Beat.Slashed and staff slash requests remain independent. Native Guitar Pro and pinned AlphaTab preserve different track-group configurations and all notes. Native GP8 shares one notation configuration across a track; differing later-staff requests remain explicit target limitations. The published checklist does not require conflicting settings within one track. Native evidence confirms distinct track groups; earlier same-track review suggestions describe a target limit, not an additional acceptance requirement.
